title: Post-op Prednisone and Glucose Monitoring in TKA
official: Postoperative Prednisone Regimen in TKA and Its Effect on Continuous Glucose Levels
summary: This study compares the efficacy of a 5-day post-operative oral prednisone regimen (40 mg daily) with the standard intraoperative steroid regimen, focusing on pain, swelling, range of motion, opioid use, and glucose levels monitored continuously.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* MUST BE CONTACTED BY THE STUDY TEAM TO BE PART OF THE STUDY. No applications taken
* Undergoing Primary Unicompartmental Knee Arthroplasty or Total Hip Arthroplasty
* Age 18 and above
* Patient at Columbia University Irving Medical Center and be undergoing planned surgery by Dr. Roshan P. Shah

Exclusion Criteria:

* Steroid therapy
* Narcotic use within past 3 months
* History of corticosteroid intolerance
* Pregnancy
* Uncontrolled diabetes
* Doesn't own smart phone

Drop Criteria:

\- 2nd dose of IV dexamethasone
